text:
nina: Anyone up for grabbing food after the Summit wrap? Guest in town and hungry. Prefer something quick near SOMA — sandwiches, dumplings, or a taqueria.
joel: Sandwiches sound great. Ike's or Little Lu's? Ike's is packed on weekends.
tara: Little Lu's on Folsom has good banh mi-ish stuff and rice-paper wraps (gluten-free option). Open til 11.
ben: If it's dumplings, Dumpling Den on 5th has a late window and steamers to go.
guest-kate: Crunchy + portable please. Also vegetarian options are nice.

lunchbot: Poll created: react 1 for sandwiches, 2 for dumplings, 3 for tacos.
nina: 1

lunchbot: Results: sandwiches 4, dumplings 1, tacos 0.

nina: Looks like sandwiches. Who wants pickup vs meet there? I can pick up if people Venmo.
joel: I'll Venmo $14 for mine.
tara: Meeting there, need to stretch my legs after sessions. ETA ~10:05pm.
ben: Can you ask for no mayo on mine and extra cilantro?

guest-kate: Veggie wrap for me, no fish sauce please.
nina: Ordering for 6. Plan: meet by the conference north exit at 10:00 or pick up at 10:20. Link: https://example.com/littlelus-menu

(last) nina: Heading out in 5, will DM payment and post when I have the bags.
